exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Conditional perfect and complex passive

items.prompt: Had we not resolved the three cases, they ___ into a material problem.
items.hintAfterError: Condicional perfeito: would + have + particípio (grow é irregular).

items.prompt: If the penalty ___ earlier, the board would have been informed.
The late filing is ___ to have caused the second penalty.
items.hintAfterError: Passiva complexa: is + particípio + to have + particípio.

items.prompt: It is the unglamorous ___ of small cases that keeps us out of trouble.
Never ___ we underestimate how quickly small penalties accumulate.
items.hintAfterError: Com 'Never' no início há inversão: o auxiliar vem antes do sujeito.
